note: Both sets capture the five chordwise-offset reference lines (pitch axis, mass, neutral, geometric, shear centers) from Figure 2-11. Set A adds a claim that axial stiffness is 1e10 N at r/R = 1.0, but 1e10 is only the y-axis scale multiplier of plot (c); the curve at r/R = 1.0 is near zero, so the value is misread and misbound to the wrong span position. Set B omits that erroneous claim and otherwise matches Set A, making it the more faithful set.
remarks: Both sets only extract legend labels of Figure 2-11 as 'structural property center' claims with no numeric chordwise offset values, which is thin but symmetric. Neither set extracts the mass density or edge/flap/torsional stiffness data from Figure 2-10; the axis scale factors (1e11, 1e10) are easy to mistake for data values, as Set A demonstrates.
